title: Herbal Light Turkish Cornmeal Pilaf
description: A gentle, fragrant pilaf made with cornmeal, fresh herbs, and a bright lemon deglaze-ideal for kids and halal-friendly.
instructions: Warm the vegetable broth in a saucepan until it just simmers.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, thyme, and rosemary; cook for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Pour in the cornmeal and stir constantly to toast it lightly for 2 minutes.
Deglaze the pan with a splash of warm vegetable broth, scraping up any browned bits.
Gradually add the remaining broth, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring after each addition until the mixture thickens.
Fold in the frozen peas, lemon zest, and lemon juice; let simmer until the peas are heated through, about 5 minutes.
Serve warm, optionally garnishing with a light drizzle of olive oil.
